Now Lingo Room will download the neural network models necessary for translation and speech recognition, once finished you can start using the app (even offline).

The Group Conversation mode is the main feature of Lingo Room, it allows you to translate a conversation between several people in real time, for a better experience it is recommended to connect bluetooth headphones to the phone, furthermore the application will continue to work also in background and with the phone on standby (however, some phones may have performance issues when the app runs in the background)
Conversation mode translates a face to face conversation on one phone. Speak in either language and the other person hears the translation.

Lingo Room uses OpenAi\'s Whisper for speech recognition and Meta\'s NLLB for translations, these models require quite a bit of power and at least 6GB of RAM to run, so make sure you\'re using a modern smartphone to avoid slowdowns or crashes. Lingo Room is built on the open source RTranslator project, which you can find here
To speak, Lingo Room uses the system\'s default TTS engine, the recommended TTS is the Google TTS, but you can choose the one you prefer, to select it, click on the button below
Notifications will be used only to improve background operations like the downloads or other background tasks. This app will never send notifications.
To use Group Conversation mode, allow Lingo Room to use Bluetooth.
To use Conversation mode, allow Lingo Room to access your microphone.

To translate your voice in Group Conversation mode, allow Lingo Room to access your microphone. If you don\'t grant this permission, the mode will still work, but you will only be able to send text messages or receive and play translations.
Mono language lightweight models created by Mozilla; they have a similar quality to 2024\'s Google Translate. \n\nModel: Mozilla 16-60M fp32
Middleweight model created by Tencent; it has the best quality, better than Google Translate, comparable to Deepseek v3 and Gemini 3.0. \n\nModel: HY-MT-1.5 1.8B int8
Heavy model created by Google; it has a quality in-between the Mozilla and HY-MT models but supports 400 languages. \n\nModel: Madlad 3B int4
Use peformance models (Mozilla) for Conversation and Group Conversation modes to reduce latency in Real-Time translation modes, but with worse quality.

Lets Lingo Room keep listening during a phone call

Experimental. Android only lets an app use the microphone during a phone call if this is turned on. Lingo Room uses it for that alone: it does not read your screen, your messages or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.

Interpret a normal phone call that is on loudspeaker.

Android only lets an app listen during a call if its accessibility service is on. Tap the button below, find "Lingo Room call mode" in the list (it may be under Installed apps or Downloaded apps) and turn it on. Then come back here.

Lingo Room uses this only to keep the microphone. It does not read your screen.

Call mode is ready.

1. Choose your language and the caller's language on the home screen.
2. Answer or make the call and turn on the loudspeaker.
3. Come back to Lingo Room and tap Start.
4. Keep the phone in front of you. Speak after the caller has finished, one at a time.

The caller will hear your voice and then the translation. This is an experiment: on some phones the caller may hear the translation faintly or not at all.
